info.title: MiniMax API
info.description: Use this API to query the status of a video generation task.

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: The task ID to query. Only tasks created by the current account can be queried.

file_id.description: Returned on success. File ID for retrieving the video file.

video_width.description: Returned on success. Width of the generated video in pixels.

video_height.description: Returned on success. Height of the generated video in pixels.

VideoProcessStatus.description:
Current status of the task. Possible values:
- `Preparing` – Preparing
- `Queueing` – Queueing
- `Processing` – Processing
- `Success` – Success
- `Fail` – Failed

status_code.description:
Status codes:
- 0: Request succeeded
- 1002: Rate limit triggered, please retry later
- 1004: Authentication failed, please check if the API key is correct
- 1026: Input content involves sensitive content
- 1027: Generated video involves sensitive content

status_msg.description: Status message. `success` when the request succeeds.

bearerAuth.description: Pass `Authorization: Bearer <token>` in the request header.
